source_model: Q-SHIFT distance-3, five-round Z-memory, balanced-regime circuit implementation; gate p=0.003; burst pair supports audited by exact single-fault mapping

exact_categorical_circuit.bounded_statistic: mean of five within-pair detector cofire indicators; X in [0,1]
exact_categorical_circuit.interpretation: Burst-p endpoint evaluation is exact for each fixed measurement p because the independent burst Bernoulli parameter enters affine in the parity-character moment formulas. The measurement-p optimization is only a finite grid. Positive grid gap suggests this bounded statistic could support a one-sided mean e-process for these tested conditions. A valid null bound requires a proved continuum supremum and a defensible conditional-mean null; this finite grid does not supply either. Detection of pair-cofire change would not identify its physical cause or establish decoder benefit.
